title: refactor(ui)!: retire plugin-designer's dead collaboration code, VersionHistory and the useConfirmDialog entry export
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb4JjPNQfBQxo6jSSRhqXFe8)_

Part of #25921. This is the `@object-ui/plugin-designer` batch named in landing note 6579769954 ("New since this batch"), under claim 6583164004 and amendment 6583226546. The card stays open. Every other item it lists is untouched: `CommentSearchResult`, the providers/upload fold, `clearSharedDiscoveryCache` and the other packages' barrel batches.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除 `@object-ui/plugin-designer` 中 #29388 之后已成死代码的协作实现：整个 `CollaborationProvider.tsx`，以及页面、数据模型、流程、报表四个设计器里永远为 null 的 `useCollaboration()` 分支和工具栏上的“N users / Connected”标记。删除无人渲染的 `VersionHistory` 组件及其测试。包入口不再导出 `VersionHistory` 和 `useConfirmDialog`。`useConfirmDialog` 模块保留，因为七个设计器内部都在用。
- 为什么改：普查（#28385 方法，`origin/main` `128681f4`，hotcrm `d4ffe99`）显示，这些名字在包外只有一个测试文件的历史注释提到，hotcrm 为零。`CollaborationProvider` 在全仓无人挂载，所以协作分支在运行时从不执行。
- 风险与回滚：Console 和其它 `@object-ui/*` 包都不导入这两个名字，不受影响。外部 npm 用户若导入会在升级时编译报错，changeset 写明了改法。设计器行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/index.tsx`、`ui/packages/plugin-designer/src/ReportDesigner.tsx`（删得最多的设计器）、`.changeset/25921-plugin-designer-dead-collaboration-version-history.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n -w -e CollaborationProvider -e useCollaboration -e VersionHistory -- ui/packages/plugin-designer ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'`，预期无输出（退出码 1）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（入队前欠一次契约复审档复审，由席位转总监）。

## What changes

- **Dead collaboration code.** `src/CollaborationProvider.tsx` is deleted: the provider, `useCollaboration`, `ConnectionStatusIndicator` and their types. `CollaborationProvider` left the entry in #29388 and nothing mounts it anywhere, so `useCollaboration()` always returned `null`. In `PageDesigner` and `ReportDesigner`, the `broadcastOp` callback, its call sites and the `broadcastOp` entries in the hook dependency lists go. `DataModelDesigner` and `ProcessDesigner` lose their `collaboration?.sendOperation(...)` calls and the `collaboration` dependency entries. The always-hidden "N users" status chip (DataModel, Process) and the "Connected" chip (Report, with its local `LABELS.collaborationConnected`) go too, as does the now-unused `Users` icon import in `DataModelDesigner`. `AppCreationWizard` and `ObjectManager` had no collaboration branch.
- **`VersionHistory`.** `src/components/VersionHistory.tsx` and its test `VersionHistory.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx` are deleted, along with its two `components/index.ts` lines and the entry line. Nothing in the package rendered it. The `VersionHistory` case leaves `ariaLabelNames.zh-12145.test.tsx`: the zh wait now anchors on the minimap image. The undo, redo and minimap names are still asserted against both packs.
- **`useConfirmDialog`.** Only the entry line goes. `hooks/useConfirmDialog.ts` and its `hooks/index.ts` line stay, because `AppCreationWizard`, `DataModelDesigner`, `FieldDesigner`, `ObjectManager`, `PageDesigner`, `ProcessDesigner` and `ReportDesigner` import it. `hooks/index.ts` is a sub-barrel nothing imports, the same state #29388 left it in.
- `README.md` stops teaching both names. `package.json`'s description drops "plus collaborative editing". One comment line in `useDesignerTranslation.ts` stops naming `VersionHistory`'s region.
- One `!` changeset (`patch`, `**BREAKING**` banner, both declaration lines, the ADR-0087 `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` marker naming both operands, and a FROM → TO "no replacement" line per name).

## Why

The #28385 census was re-run before any edit at `origin/main` `128681f4` (hotcrm `d4ffe99`). For each name, `git grep -l -w -F` ran over the whole tree minus `ui/packages/plugin-designer/**`, `**/CHANGELOG.md`, the lockfiles, `.changeset/**` and `ui/.changeset/**` (A). The brief's cut (`ui packages apps examples content`, tests excluded) is B, test files only is T and hotcrm is H. IN counts the in-package non-test files.

| name | on the entry before | A | B | T | H | IN | result |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|:--|
| `ObjectGantt` (control) | gantt | 189 | 53 | 134 | 0 | 0 | control hits |
| `SchemaRenderer` (control) | react | 1168 | 299 | 841 | 3 | 0 | control hits |
| `CreateAppPage` (kept control) | yes | 49 | 4 | 45 | 0 | 3 | stays |
| `useConfirmDialog` | yes | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 11 | leaves the entry; module stays |
| `VersionHistory` | yes | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 5 | leaves the entry; module deleted |
| `VersionHistoryProps` | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 2 | deleted with the module |
| `VersionHistoryEntry` | no | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 2 | deleted with the module |
| `DesignerConfirmDialogState` | no | 1 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 2 | stays (module stays) |
| `CollaborationProvider` | no (left in #29388) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 5 | deleted |
| `CollaborationProviderProps` | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | deleted |
| `CollaborationContextValue` | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | deleted |
| `useCollaboration` | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 5 | deleted |
| `ConnectionStatusIndicator` | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | deleted |

The single A/T hit for `useConfirmDialog`, `VersionHistory`, `VersionHistoryEntry` and `DesignerConfirmDialogState` is one file, `ui/scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`. Its historical comments ("`ConfirmDialogState` sat here", "`VersionEntry` sat here") name the module paths. Under the claim, that comment does not keep a name. Keep rule 3: no kept entry export's declared signature names any retired type. Each appears only in its own module and its sub-barrel.

After the change, at the merged head `d7514fc8`, the same `git grep` over the whole tree (CHANGELOGs and changesets excluded) finds zero files for `CollaborationProvider`, `CollaborationProviderProps`, `CollaborationContextValue`, `useCollaboration`, `ConnectionStatusIndicator` and `VersionHistoryProps`. `VersionHistory`, `VersionHistoryEntry` and `useConfirmDialog` outside the package appear only in that test comment. `useConfirmDialog` is absent from `src/index.tsx` and `README.md` (`git grep` exit 1). Control: `SchemaRenderer` 1207 files.

## Tests

- Code head `fb1192c3`; `d7514fc8` merges 10 `origin/main` commits, none under `ui/packages/plugin-designer` (branch delta re-read: the same 14 files, +52 / -573).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-designer run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): `VERDICT command-exit 0` on `fb1192c3` and again on `d7514fc8`.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-designer/`: Test Files 49 passed (49), Tests 456 passed (456), `VERDICT command-exit 0` on both heads.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/` (includes `check-readme-exports`) on `fb1192c3`: Test Files 169 passed, 2 skipped (171); Tests 4921 passed, 2 skipped; `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `eslint` on the eight changed source and test files: 0 errors, 18 warnings, all on lines this diff does not touch.
- No ablation: this diff only deletes code, removes export lines and edits README text, so no tested behaviour changed. The zero-hit census above is the proof.

## Acceptance notes

- `designer.versionHistory` is now unread. Its only reader was `VersionHistory`. Per the claim it stays in the ten locale packs and in `DESIGNER_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, the table the en-pack mirror gate compares. It is left for the dead-key item.
- The historical comments in `ui/scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` still name `packages/plugin-designer/src/components/VersionHistory.tsx`, a path this PR deletes. They are a "sat here" record of an older rename, outside this claim's surface, and left as they are.
- `@object-ui/types`' `CollaborationConfig`, `CollaborationPresence` and `CollaborationOperation` lose this package as a reader. `@object-ui/collaboration` still imports all three, so they stay.
- The importers of this package (`@object-ui/app-shell`'s lazy designer pages, the Console) were not type-checked locally. The census shows neither imports either retired name (B = 0), and CI's `Type Check UI` compiles them.
- A `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review is owed before the queue (an entry narrowing). The seat routes it to the director.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates: 46/46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `fb1192c3` gave 46 commands. `--ran` reports "46 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Every command exited 0. Among them: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` and `--self-test`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-sdui-manifest` and its `--self-test`, `check:published-files`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:query-options-erasure` (293 s), `check-comment-mask-corpus` (20193 files, 0 disagree), `check:type-check-debt` (locked, 0 raw tsc errors) and `vitest run scripts/`.

At `d7514fc8` the derived list is identical. `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:published-files`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports` and `check:test-source-alias` were re-run there, all exit 0.

Outside the derived set: `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` exit 0 (0 anchored files). `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate, 625 changed lines (under the 3000 threshold), no governed path.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (no names added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `eslint` on the changed files exits 0 (warnings only, all pre-existing). The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
